newsitem.title: UK: Middlesex shares rise on press report.
newsitem.headline: Middlesex shares rise on press report.

text.p: Middlesex Holdings Plc inched higher in active dealings on Thursday after a press report that said dealers were betting the group would post a sharp increase in profits next month, dealers said.
At 0805 GMT, the shares were up 1/4p at 8-1/2p, a 10-month high. They were the second most heavily traded shares in London.

The Daily Mail noted that volume in the shares has been relatively heavy in recent sessions amid talk the UK conglomerate would report annual pre-tax profits of about 10 million stg, compared with 5.2 million stg in the previous year.
